title: Simple app that does ist job
body: I have tried the several apps out there and this one is the most convincing with it's simplicity and fair pricing. However, last days they are playing with pricing and I am not sure where it will results. The new offer is much higher than considered value.
author: xyzajac

title: Premium
body: I’ve bought premium in this app few days ago. Then it switched from lifetime premium to subscription after like 3 days, and my money is lost, now I have only free version of the app again and developer is not responding.
author: SpX797

title: Latest update is just plain wrong
body:
I loved the app up until it’s latest update. Before this update I paid the one time payment of 10.99€ as my thank you to developers.
But after latest update everytime I launch the app there’s an annoying offer that pops up and even after I close it it remains as a first option on the screen. Seriously? And the pricing is also just wrong. 40€ per year for this app is just too much. I’d pay 10. But 40€ for a reminder? Sorry guys. I understand that value is subjective but if you believe in your product just get rid of that popup and trust that people will buy it if they love it
author: wyktoko
